tools.name: explain_electricity_offer
tools.description: Explain one electricity contract from a comparison in plain language: what a spot contract is, the markup and fee for the user, the yearly supplier cost at the given usage, the data source and date, and whether we earn a commission.

tools.name: get_signup_link
tools.description: Get the link for one offer from a comparison (electricity, savings or deposits). The link is the provider's own page unless the result says affiliate: true. Nothing about the user is sent.
